decisions.reason: It has remained on its own page from 2023 to 2024, suggesting results at or above aspiration levels for a core-adjacent line, so a long-term German lighting firm is likely to retain it.
Its continued full presentation over two years indicates acceptable market acceptance for a product close to the established range, reducing pressure for problemistic search and withdrawal.
Although newly launched in 2024, it fits the firm's core modular lighting offer and is likely to be given more time under organisational slack before any discontinuation decision.
As a complementary canopy product that builds on the existing system offer, it likely supports broader sales and dealer/planner relationships, which favors keeping it despite limited history.
This low-voltage canopy extends the firm's established system logic, and even if early standalone results are modest, its complementarity makes retention more likely than rapid exit.

The weaker 2024 website presence only as a mention raises concern that results are below aspiration, but because it is still close to the design-led core range the firm would more likely continue testing than drop it immediately.
